intent.text:
Seat sec. The three pending texts (ses's, rec's standing intent, and my standing intent) differ only in phrasing. Substance is the same: remove the global rule now, confirm in a fresh session, record the identity gap, run the chaining matrix in the hook-rewritten form on a scratch project with project scope, reinstate only the literal export CC_AGENT=' prefix if every case prompts, and verify the two-hook combination and TUI prompt last.

I support ses's text because it has the floor and it is the most compact. The only addition I'd want in it is the case list from my standing intent, which ses's already includes, plus the newline-inside-the-value case, which it also includes. So I have nothing to add, and I'd take the vote on ses's text as it stands.
